title: Booking Appointments
content:
I don't have any issues with the quality of care given once you eventually obtain an appointment. 
Something has got to be done to improve the way an appointment to see a Doctor can be obtained. Many people have very real concerns about there health problems and need that Face to Face with a medical expert for that all important life saving early diagnosis so the relevant treatment can be prescribed.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
